info.title: Soyuz API
info.description: Soyuz accepts authenticated run requests, stores canonical run state, and exposes run, artifact, publication, and worker lifecycle operations. Successful REST responses use a data/requestId envelope. Errors use an error object containing code, message, and requestId. Run records and associated artifacts are retained for 90 days.

get.description: Public readiness check for the Worker, required API credentials, and required D1 schema.
Returns the public UTCP manual for the bounded agent tools. Its tool templates use the client bearer credential; the manual contains no secret values.
Returns newest-first run summaries. The default page size is 30 and the maximum is 100. Pagination is independent of the 90-day retention window.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation cursor from a previous response.

post.description: Validates and queues a run. A fresh request returns 202. A matching idempotency replay may return 200; reuse the same key and request after an uncertain response. Kaseki submission credentials may also call this operation when configured.

example.taskPrompt: Add a health endpoint and update the API documentation.

200.description: Existing run returned for an idempotency replay

post.description: Creates one new run from a terminal source run. The new run records retryOf. A matching retry idempotency key replays the same run. Kaseki submission credentials may also call this operation when configured.

200.description: Existing retry returned for an idempotency replay

get.description: Returns append-only operational events in sequence order.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return events after this sequence number.

post.description: Cancels queued or claimed work, or records cancellation intent for running work. Kaseki submission credentials may also call this operation when configured.

get.description: Lists retained artifact metadata. Artifact bytes are available from the artifact download operation.
Returns the artifact bytes as an attachment after checking caller authorization, run retention, and artifact expiry.
Returns a safe publication ledger projection and validated legacy published URL. It never returns manifest bytes, storage keys, raw RPC bodies, or credentials.
Returns aggregate assessment, grade, score, improvement category, and phase duration summaries across unexpired runs, with a bounded per-run projection.
Returns artifact storage totals, operational cleanup information, upload rejection counts, and a dry-run retention impact projection.
Returns a bounded cursor-paginated projection without worker lease data, request content, arbitrary errors, logs, repository contents, or artifacts. The default and maximum page size is 30.

post.description: Admits a bounded request using the client bearer key and returns a sanitized projection. publishMode defaults to pr. Use idempotencyKey and reuse it after uncertain responses.

200.description: Existing run returned for an idempotency replay

get.description: Returns at most 200 events per page. Event payloads are allowlisted and bounded.

post.description: Records cancellation intent and returns sanitized run detail.

get.summary: Read canonical run state as a worker

post.description: Atomically claims a queued run. callbackId is also the per-attempt fencing token; echo it as claimCallbackId in subsequent callbacks.

200.description: Run claimed or matching claim replayed

post.description: Events are bounded operational metadata, not stdout or stderr. Event payloads are limited to 12 KB. Reuse eventId and the same payload when retrying.
May also persist a pre-execution admission failure for a live claimed run.
Confirms that a worker has stopped a run. A live claim may also report a confirmed pre-start cancellation.

put.description: Streams one artifact (maximum 25,000,000 bytes); at most 100 artifacts are retained per run. Retries with the same artifact ID, bytes, and metadata are idempotent. Requires the current worker and claim IDs.

parameters.name: X-Artifact-Name
parameters.description: Optional printable filename; defaults to artifact-{artifactId}.

parameters.name: X-Artifact-Kind
parameters.description: Optional artifact kind; defaults to other.
UUIDv7 artifact identifier from the publication manifest.

put.description: Uploads a validated Kirisame publication artifact v1 (maximum request size 9 MiB). Requires the active claim fence and server-side publication policy. The manifest is kept private.

200.description: Manifest stored or matching upload replayed

post.description: Registers one idempotent intent for a live run. PR mode requires title and body; branch mode rejects PR metadata. Soyuz checks the uploaded manifest, validation evidence, canonical run destination, and repository allowlist before accepting the intent.

200.description: Intent registered or matching intent replayed

ClientBearer.description: Client API token sent as Authorization: Bearer <CLIENT_API_TOKEN>.

KasekiSubmissionBearer.description: Optional Kaseki submission token. It is restricted to run create, retry, and cancel operations and must differ from the general client token.

WorkerBearer.description: Worker API token sent as Authorization: Bearer <WORKER_API_TOKEN>. Keep it distinct from client credentials.

RunId.name: runId
RunId.description: Canonical Soyuz run UUID. Do not use the human-facing displayId in API paths.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional RFC UUID for safe retries. If both the header and request body contain a key, they must match.

PublicationStatus.description: Safe ledger projection. Internal storage keys, manifest bytes, and raw RPC data are omitted.

callbackId.description: Stable idempotency key and attempt fencing token.

payload.description: JSON event metadata, capped at 12 KB.

artifactId.description: UUIDv7 of the uploaded publication manifest.
